question: In the Commission’s view, what is the Treaty-derived legal legitimacy for the ‘Team Europe’ negotiators, i.e. the heads of state randomly selected to flank Commission President Ursula von der Leyen in her photo opportunities with North African autocrats and, under the pretence of fighting irregular migration, cut billion-euro deals propping up the local regime?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (25.7.2024) The President of the Commission’s visits to Tunisia, Egypt or Mauritania aimed to deepen the EU’s cooperation with partners on issues of mutual interest.

In the course of these visits, the President of the Commission reconfirmed comprehensive partnerships with these countries covering various policy areas from economic development, investment, trade to energy, security and migration. The President of the Commission was accompanied by leaders of the Member States.
A Team Europe approach making the most of the EU and Member States’ cooperation activities with third countries helps to ensure a strong and cohesive EU policy.
